-- WoWFA Forever - NPC names (rc11): the name line of an NPC tooltip, the name
-- above an NPC (nameplates, the V key) and the target frame name.
-- F.db.npcName: 1 = Persian only, 2 = Persian with the English under it
-- (tooltip + nameplates), 3 = English (untouched). Players are never touched.
-- Lookup = names.npc, then names.boss, by T.NameKey of the English name (the
-- export keys the same way). A name the data does not know stays English and
-- is remembered in the miss list.

local F = WoWFAF
local L = F.L
local T = F.T

local M = { id = "npc", order = 4, risk = "low", nameKey = "m_npc", descKey = "m_npc_d" }

function M.data()
    return F.D.names and F.D.names.npc
end

function M.api()
    return UnitName ~= nil and GameTooltip ~= nil
end

local function mode()
    local v = F.db and F.db.npcName
    if v ~= 2 and v ~= 3 then
        return 1
    end
    return v
end
F.NpcMode = mode

local function lookup(name, quiet)
    if not F.Usable(name) or type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if not F.Room.On("namesNpc") or mode() == 3 then
        return nil
    end
    local names = F.D.names or {}
    local key = T.NameKey(name)
    local v = (names.npc and names.npc[key]) or (names.boss and names.boss[key])
    if v == nil and not quiet and not string.find(name, "[\216-\219\239]") then
        F:Miss("npc", key, name)
    end
    return v
end
F.NpcLookup = lookup

local memo = {}
local function shaped(fa)
    local key = fa .. "\1" .. tostring(T.Mode()) .. tostring(F.Room.On("faDigits"))
    local s = memo[key]
    if not s then
        s = T.ShapeLine(T.Digits(fa), T.Mode())
        memo[key] = s
    end
    return s
end

-- font strings we rewrote: fs -> the font to give back
local orig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function put(fs, fa, en, two)
    if not orig[fs] then
        local font, size, flags = fs:GetFont()
        orig[fs] = { font = font, size = size, flags = flags }
    end
    local o = orig[fs]
    fs:SetFont(F.FONT, o.size or 12, o.flags or "")
    local s = shaped(fa)
    if two and type(en) == "string" then
        s = s .. "\n" .. en
    end
    fs:SetText(s)
end

local function unput(fs)
    local o = orig[fs]
    if o and o.font then
        pcall(fs.SetFont, fs, o.font, o.size, o.flags or "")
    end
    orig[fs] = nil
end

-- the name above a unit: the client calls CompactUnitFrame_UpdateName every
-- time it writes the name; we write ours right after it
local function plate(frame)
    if type(frame) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    local fs = frame.name
    if type(fs) ~= "table" or not fs.SetText then
        return
    end
    if not M.active then
        if orig[fs] then
            unput(fs)
        end
        return
    end
    local unit = frame.unit
    if not F.Usable(unit) or type(unit) ~= "string" or string.sub(unit, 1, 9) ~= "nameplate" then
        return
    end
    local isp = UnitIsPlayer(unit)
    local en = UnitName(unit)
    if (F.Usable(isp) and isp) or not F.Usable(en) then
        unput(fs)
        return
    end
    local fa = lookup(en, true)
    if fa then
        put(fs, fa, en, mode() == 2)
    else
        unput(fs)
    end
end
M.plate = plate

-- the unit tooltip: line 1 is the name
local function tip(tt)
    if tt ~= GameTooltip or not M.active then
        return
    end
    local name, unit = tt:GetUnit()
    if not F.Usable(name) or not F.Usable(unit) then
        return
    end
    local isp = UnitIsPlayer(unit)
    if F.Usable(isp) and isp then
        return
    end
    local fa = lookup(name)
    if not fa then
        return
    end
    if not T.Once(tt, "n|" .. tostring(name)) then
        return
    end
    local fs = _G[(tt:GetName() or "GameTooltip") .. "TextLeft1"]
    if type(fs) ~= "table" or not fs.GetText then
        return
    end
    local cur = fs:GetText()
    if not F.Usable(cur) or cur ~= name then
        return
    end
    local shown = fa
    if mode() == 2 then
        shown = fa .. "\n" .. name
    end
    pcall(T.TipSet, tt, fs, shown, nil, "Left")
    T.Done(tt)
    tt:Show()
end

-- the target frame name (a single line: Persian only)
local function target_fonts()
    local out = {}
    local function add(fs)
        if type(fs) == "table" and fs.SetText and fs.GetFont then
            out[#out + 1] = fs
        end
    end
    add(_G.TargetFrameTextureFrameName)
    local tf = _G.TargetFrame
    if type(tf) == "table" then
        add(tf.name)
        local c = tf.TargetFrameContent
        if type(c) == "table" and type(c.TargetFrameContentMain) == "table" then
            add(c.TargetFrameContentMain.Name)
        end
    end
    return out
end

local function target()
    local fonts = target_fonts()
    local fa, en
    if M.active and UnitExists and UnitExists("target") then
        local isp = UnitIsPlayer("target")
        en = UnitName("target")
        if not (F.Usable(isp) and isp) and F.Usable(en) then
            fa = lookup(en, true)
        end
    end
    for _, fs in ipairs(fonts) do
        if fa then
            put(fs, fa, en, false)
        else
            unput(fs)
        end
    end
end
M.target = target

-- the name family or the display changed: the plates and the target frame again
local function redo()
    if C_NamePlate and C_NamePlate.GetNamePlates and CompactUnitFrame_UpdateName then
        local okp, plates = pcall(C_NamePlate.GetNamePlates)
        if okp and type(plates) == "table" then
            for _, np in ipairs(plates) do
                if type(np) == "table" and np.UnitFrame then
                    pcall(CompactUnitFrame_UpdateName, np.UnitFrame)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    target()
end

function M.install()
    if TooltipDataProcessor and TooltipDataProcessor.AddTooltipPostCall and Enum and Enum.TooltipDataType
        and Enum.TooltipDataType.Unit then
        TooltipDataProcessor.AddTooltipPostCall(Enum.TooltipDataType.Unit, F:Wrap("npc", tip))
    elseif GameTooltip.HookScript then
        GameTooltip:HookScript("OnTooltipSetUnit", F:Wrap("npc", tip))
    end
    if type(CompactUnitFrame_UpdateName) == "function" then
        hooksecurefunc("CompactUnitFrame_UpdateName", function(frame)
            local ok, err = pcall(plate, frame)
            if not ok then
                F:LogError("npc", err)
            end
        end)
    end
    F:On("PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED", "npc", function()
        F.After(0, F:Wrap("npc", target))
    end)
    if type(TargetFrame_Update) == "function" then
        hooksecurefunc("TargetFrame_Update", F:Wrap("npc", target))
    end
    if type(TargetFrame) == "table" and type(TargetFrame.Update) == "function" then
        hooksecurefunc(TargetFrame, "Update", F:Wrap("npc", target))
    end
    for _, sig in ipairs({ "names", "room", "npcname" }) do
        F:Listen(sig, F:Wrap("npc", redo))
    end
end

function M.onState()
    pcall(redo)
end

F:RegisterModule(M)

ops.new:
-- rc11 (the owner: "the zone names on the map: only the two continents work"):
-- every font string under the world map (the title, the navigation bar, the zone
-- headers of the quest log, the pin labels) gets the same in-place SetText hook;
-- the walk repeats whenever the map changes because the map builds its pins
-- lazily. A font string whose text is no zone name is left alone (and never
-- logged as a miss).
local function walk_map(frame, depth, budget)
    if budget.n <= 0 or depth > 10 then
        return
    end
    budget.n = budget.n - 1
    local okr, regions = pcall(function()
        return { frame:GetRegions() }
    end)
    if okr then
        for _, r in ipairs(regions) do
            if type(r) == "table" and r.GetObjectType and r.SetText and r.GetText then
                local okt, ot = pcall(r.GetObjectType, r)
                if okt and ot == "FontString" then
                    hook_inplace(r, "maplabel")
                    local okx, txt = pcall(r.GetText, r)
                    if okx and F.Usable(txt) and type(txt) == "string" and txt ~= "" then
                        on_inplace(r, txt, "maplabel")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local okc, kids = pcall(function()
        return { frame:GetChildren() }
    end)
    if okc then
        for _, k in ipairs(kids) do
            if type(k) == "table" and k.GetRegions then
                walk_map(k, depth + 1, budget)
            end
        end
    end
end

function M.scan_map()
    local wm = WorldMapFrame
    if type(wm) ~= "table" or not M.active or not F.Room.On("namesZone") then
        return
    end
    pcall(walk_map, wm, 0, { n = 1500 })
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------ rc11: share a whole setup
-- WFP1-<tokens>-<check>: everything the user customised as one short code that
-- others can paste into their own panel (the site's WF4 code only holds the 15
-- name / text bits; a WF4 code is still accepted by ShareImport).
-- The tokens are separated by "."; the first character is the key, the rest the value:
--   s = the 15 site bits (base36)   g = the game bits (base36)   p = faPlace (1 / 2)
--   t / e = General title / description display (1-3)
--   b / a = the spellbook / talents section: custom 0|1, title, description (3 digits)
--   n = the NPC name display (1-3)   c = colours on (0|1)
--   u v w x y q r = the colour index of zn / sp / npc / cls / it / tm / ob
local SHARE_COL = { u = "zn", v = "sp", w = "npc", x = "cls", y = "it", q = "tm", r = "ob" }
local SHARE_COL_ORDER = { "u", "v", "w", "x", "y", "q", "r" }
local SHARE_SEC = { { "b", "spellbook" }, { "a", "talents" } }

local function share_check(s)
    local a = 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        a = (a + string.byte(s, i) * (i % 89 + 1)) % 46656
    end
    local out = b36num(a)
    while #out < 3 do
        out = "0" .. out
    end
    return out
end

local function raw_on(k)
    local v = db().d[k]
    if v == nil then
        v = (Room.GAME_DEFAULT[k] ~= false)
    end
    return v ~= false
end

local function bits_of(keys)
    local n = 0
    for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
        if raw_on(k) then
            n = n + 2 ^ (i - 1)
        end
    end
    return n
end

function Room.ShareExport()
    local d = db().d
    local t = {}
    t[#t + 1] = "s" .. b36num(bits_of(Room.SITE_KEYS))
    t[#t + 1] = "g" .. b36num(bits_of(Room.GAME_KEYS))
    t[#t + 1] = "p" .. tostring(d.faPlace == 2 and 2 or 1)
    t[#t + 1] = "t" .. tostring(F.Disp("*", "title"))
    t[#t + 1] = "e" .. tostring(F.Disp("*", "desc"))
    for _, e in ipairs(SHARE_SEC) do
        t[#t + 1] = e[1] .. (F.DispCustom(e[2]) and "1" or "0") .. tostring(F.Disp(e[2], "title")) .. tostring(F.Disp(e[2], "desc"))
    end
    t[#t + 1] = "n" .. tostring(F.NpcMode and F.NpcMode() or 1)
    local col = type(F.db.col) == "table" and F.db.col or {}
    t[#t + 1] = "c" .. (col.on and "1" or "0")
    for _, k in ipairs(SHARE_COL_ORDER) do
        t[#t + 1] = k .. tostring(F.ColIndex and F.ColIndex(SHARE_COL[k]) or 1)
    end
    local payload = table.concat(t, ".")
    return "WFP1-" .. payload .. "-" .. share_check(payload)
end

-- returns true + the mode, or nil + a Persian reason
function Room.ShareImport(code)
    if type(code) ~= "string" then
        return nil, "کد خالی است"
    end
    code = string.gsub(code, "%s+", "")
    if code == "" then
        return nil, "کد خالی است"
    end
    if string.lower(string.sub(code, 1, 4)) == "wf4-" then
        return Room.Decode(code)
    end
    local payload, cc = string.match(code, "^[Ww][Ff][Pp]1%-([%w%.]+)%-(%w%w%w)$")
    if not payload then
        return nil, "این کد شکل کد تنظیمات (WFP1) نیست"
    end
    if share_check(payload) ~= string.lower(cc) then
        return nil, "رقم کنترل کد درست نیست؛ یک حرف جا افتاده یا عوض شده"
    end
    local vals = {}
    for tok in string.gmatch(payload, "[^%.]+") do
        vals[string.sub(tok, 1, 1)] = string.sub(tok, 2)
    end
    local function num36(s)
        if s == nil or s == "" then
            return nil
        end
        local n = 0
        for i = 1, #s do
            local v = B36I[string.sub(s, i, i)]
            if v == nil then
                return nil
            end
            n = n * 36 + v
        end
        return n
    end
    local s, g = num36(vals.s), num36(vals.g)
    if not s or not g then
        return nil, "کد ناقص است"
    end
    local r = db()
    local d = {}
    for i, k in ipairs(Room.SITE_KEYS) do
        d[k] = (floor(s / 2 ^ (i - 1)) % 2) == 1
    end
    for i, k in ipairs(Room.GAME_KEYS) do
        d[k] = (floor(g / 2 ^ (i - 1)) % 2) == 1
    end
    d.faPlace = (vals.p == "2") and 2 or 1
    r.d = d
    r.m = mode_of(d)
    local dd = disp_db()
    dd.title = mode3(vals.t) or 2
    dd.desc = mode3(vals.e) or 2
    dd.sec = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(SHARE_SEC) do
        local v = vals[e[1]]
        if v and #v == 3 then
            dd.sec[e[2]] = { custom = string.sub(v, 1, 1) == "1", title = mode3(string.sub(v, 2, 2)) or 2,
                desc = mode3(string.sub(v, 3, 3)) or 2 }
        end
    end
    local n = tonumber(vals.n)
    if n == 1 or n == 2 or n == 3 then
        F.db.npcName = n
    end
    if type(F.db.col) ~= "table" then
        F.db.col = {}
    end
    F.db.col.on = vals.c == "1"
    for _, k in ipairs(SHARE_COL_ORDER) do
        local idx = tonumber(vals[k])
        local ids = F.ColIds and F.ColIds(SHARE_COL[k]) or {}
        if idx and ids[idx] then
            F.db.col[SHARE_COL[k]] = ids[idx]
        end
    end
    Room.Changed()
    F:Fire("disp")
    F:Fire("npcname")
    return true, r.m
end

-- a one-line code box: read-only (the text can only be selected and copied) or editable
local function code_box(parent, editable)
    UI.Glass(parent, 0.6)
    local eb = CreateFrame("EditBox", nil, parent)
    eb:SetMultiLine(false)
    eb:SetAutoFocus(false)
    eb:SetMaxLetters(0)
    eb:SetFont(F.FONT, 11, "")
    eb:SetTextColor(C.text[1], C.text[2], C.text[3])
    eb:SetSize(PW - 30, 22)
    eb:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", parent, "TOPLEFT", 6, -2)
    eb:SetScript("OnEscapePressed", function(self)
        self:ClearFocus()
    end)
    eb:SetScript("OnEditFocusGained", function(self)
        self:HighlightText()
    end)
    if not editable then
        eb.wfaFixed = ""
        eb:SetScript("OnTextChanged", function(self, user)
            if user then
                self:SetText(self.wfaFixed or "")
                self:HighlightText()
            end
        end)
        eb.SetFixed = function(self, s)
            self.wfaFixed = s or ""
            self:SetText(self.wfaFixed)
            self:SetCursorPosition(0)
        end
    end
    return eb
end
